title: Announce store cache left stale after partial accept write failure
description: announce_store.rs accept() inserts the cache entry only after BOTH writes succeed (state then floor). If the floor write fails after the state write succeeded, accept returns Err but durable state now holds next while the cache keeps the old value; for an already-cached originator subsequent load() calls short-circuit on the cache and never re-consult disk, so monotonicity is enforced against the lower cached floor until restart and a seq in (old, next) can overwrite durable state with a lower-but-still-forward value. No pin change, durable floor never drops below old floor (liveness/consistency-of-cache only). Fix: insert the cache entry immediately after the state write succeeds — state-first is the commit point. Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
